Khalistani Terrorist Gurpatwant Singh Pannun has issued a new threat. Pannun has warned Passengers to not to fly on Air India flights from November 1 to 19.

Why did Canada reject India's request? Did Canadian negligence lead to the death of 329 people? Tune in to Flashback with Palki Sharma and find out.
